printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right.
row_scope: All 65 explicit nonstop rows in the selected headings, plus one audited and excluded DFW–CMH through row. Other connecting/through itineraries not transcribed or counted.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily, X excludes listed weekdays; 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not arrival-date rollover.

special_cases.New York: L=LaGuardia, E=Newark, J=Kennedy. NAS flights 92/93 use LGA, not EWR.
special_cases.DFW–NAS: 522 eastbound and 521 westbound exclude Wednesday and Saturday (X36).
special_cases.CMH: DFW–CMH 210 has one stop via CVG. DFW–CVG and CVG–CMH already exist; exclude the duplicate through itinerary. No CMH–DFW nonstop row was found in the reviewed return table.
special_cases.PBI–FLL: 538 has its own printed 17:25–17:45 physical leg after DFW–PBI; 45 minutes on the ground.
special_cases.airport_locations: Two new historical-airfield markers, NAS and SLC; modern reference coordinates approximate the airfields, not 1986 aircraft positions.
